turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My son has a spelling test tomorrow and he's getting really upset about it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Poor thing. How many words does he need to learn?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fifteen, and he's only got about half of them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a good start. Focus on the ones he's missing and make it a game, like spelling them out loud while bouncing a ball.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He'd love that actually. Should we keep going tonight or

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do one short round of ten minutes, then stop. A quick review at breakfast will help more than a long session tonight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Breakfast, good idea. He's always more cheerful in the morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Perfect. And remind him that getting most of them right is still a great result.
